early.name: Titanic Magazine
early.annotation: Greatly increases your magazine, allowing effortless waveclear, and lets you trade (Not often) sometimes with the enemy in lane with your raw gun. This will make your Tesla Bullets buy WAY better.

early.name: Tesla Bullets
early.annotation: Gun Ivy's BEST early/mid game item. Procs easily with ivy's high ROF, grants amazing jungle/camp clear, and allows easy proccage of debuffs. It is INSANE.

mid.name: Headhunter
mid.annotation: Can be bought earlier to make use of raw trade damage it provides. Real value comes from large % heal that is impactful late game with 5khp+ with siphon and colossus.1

mid.name: Slowing Bullets
mid.annotation: Item is VERY good right now with its base weapon damage being better early, and valve constantly nerfing all movement, meaning this item is great for making enemes EVEN slower.

mid.name: Siphon Bullets
mid.annotation: When bought at around 20-25k souls, this item will actually feel effective due to characters starting to be at the 2500-3000HP range. Optimally, you want enemies to be at 3k+HP for this item to SHINE.

late.name: Healing Tempo
late.annotation: Potentially good late game item, but only buy if you are behind, and can instead pivot to support any allied M1 characters. Your better off buying items for yourself when ahead, or even on souls.

late.name: Transcendent Cooldown
late.annotation: Treat this as a § 50k+ Soul Luxury item to let you proc Headhunter, Siphon, and Capacitor faster, alongside giving ability cooldowns. Very high value late game, but useless if you are buying it early.

picks.name: Silencer
picks.annotation: While inhibitor is great, this item INSTANTLY applies the damage debuff without needing a buildup. Great for spirit meta. Built-In Silence is also great for countering. Do note this gives no HP.

picks.name: Crippling Headshot
picks.annotation: Deletes victor, and heavily cripples any character that has high resists with high healing/sustain. Long debuff duration and easy proc makes it SUPER useful for your team needing damage.

picks.name: Slowing Bullets

3970837787.annotation: Only good when you are spending all of your money late game, and specifically only have §1600 souls after a purchase to get spirit resist before a major fight. Usually happens at §35k+ Soul Count.

989206714.annotation: Theoretically amazing with siphon, but more often situational than a core item, and beserker is likely a better alternative with siphon. Could be preferable if team constantly debuffs you even wDispel

2463960640.annotation: This is a good item to stack more bullet resist, but you are often better off with bullet resilience as replacing this for titanic should not be considered unless you are ultra late game.

2480592370.annotation: Generally you will already have enough firerate to proc debuffs on multiple people without this item, and are better off spending the money on more debuffs. Great at § 50k+ Souls however.

2221211450.annotation: Spellslinger has been indirectly HEAVILY nerfed from the gun ivy playstyle. Fleetfoot is significantly worse on her, and you cant pop tether anymore. This removes two sources of proccing spellslinger.

1055679805.annotation: A good option to use after ulting with damage amp to heal a significant amount in a short time. Refilling ammo is also great if you are struggling with that. Gives some small nice stats as well.

1427630806.annotation: Potentially good late game item, but only buy if you are behind, and can instead pivot to support any allied M1 characters. Your better off buying items for yourself when ahead, or even on souls.
